profile.headline: Founder & CEO @ Skynet Solutions | Full Stack Developer | API Engineer | NoSQL | SQL | Excel | HTML | CSS | JS | React | React Native | Python | PHP | Bash | SEO | Google Ads | GTM | GA4 | Meta | TikTok | SnapChat
profile.summary:
I am the CEO and Founder of Skynet Solutions, where I blend creativity and technology to drive innovation and deliver custom-tailored tech solutions. With a strong foundation in affiliate marketing and extensive experience with lead generation platforms like Ringba, Leadspedia, and TrackDrive, I specialize in building complete tech infrastructures that help organizations thrive in the digital age.

My journey began with nearly four years as a Software Support Specialist for a real estate management software company, where I gained invaluable experience in UX/UI design, project management, and API integrations. This role honed my ability to resolve complex issues, guide clients through CRM applications, and collaborate with software engineers to deliver efficient solutions.

At Skynet Solutions, I lead a team that creates everything from dashboards and automation scripts to websites, mobile apps, and APIs. Our goal is to integrate the latest technology into cohesive systems that improve organizational efficiency and drive results. My technical expertise includes API engineering, SQL and NoSQL databases, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, React Native, Python, and PHP.

I believe that creativity is the ultimate driving force for innovation and progress, and coding is the perfect outlet for my passion. It allows me to push boundaries, express ideas, and deliver exceptional results that make a real impact.
